question.text: Foreign contributions received by an NPO in India are regulated under FCRA 2010, administered by which Ministry?

answer.text: Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs
Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) — NPOs must register under FCRA to accept foreign donations

explanation.text: The Logic: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) regulates NPOs receiving foreign contributions under FCRA 2010, and NPOs must register under FCRA before accepting foreign donations. The Trap: The MCA regulates Section 8 Companies but not FCRA. The Ministry of Finance covers banking and capital markets. The MEA is foreign-policy facing rather than the FCRA administrator. Only MHA fits the FCRA administration role. Note: When foreign contribution is part of the NPO's funding stack, verify FCRA registration is in force and current annual filings have been made before relying on those inflows in the assessment.
